title: Laser Capture Microdissection (LCM) and 3D Sample Tracking Protocol
protocol: Turn on the computer.
Turn on the Eclipse™ Ti-E microscope base using the switch located on the back of the microscope.
Turn on the ArcturusXT™ Instrument. The power button is located on the left side of the instrument facing the microscope.
Start the software by clicking the ArcturusXT™ icon on the Windows™ desktop or through Start, Programs, and click the ArcturusXT™ option.
In the setup tool panel click Present Stage.
Load slides and CapSure™ Caps onto the microscope stage.
Click on HS or Macro in the Load Caps panel depending on which cap is being used.
Represent the number of caps loaded by clicking the empty circles.
Select the slide panel to choose which slot your working slide was placed (A, B or C).
Click the box to the right of the chosen letter slot to select the slide type: MEM for membrane slide, FRM for frame slide, or no check mark for a glass slide.
If using frame slides, place a clean glass slide on the flat side of the membrane slide as support for the tissue section.
Take a slide overview image by clicking the camera icon and selecting “reacquire overview image” in the dialog box that appears when right-clicking the tiled picture area.
Take a tile image of the entire tissue section by clicking the tile image button, then dragging the cursor to outline the whole tissue section on the slide overview image.
Use the camera button to take 2x, 10x and 20x overview images of your region of interest (Overview ROI).
Place cap on ROI using the 2x or 10x objective.
Calibrate and center the IR laser spot diameter and power after placing the cap over the ROI.
Locate a clear area close to the sample for testing the IR spot size and strength.
Draw a circle around the sample to be collected using the freehand drawing button with the 10x objective.
Calibrate IR laser.
Mark sample area.
Click on cut and capture button.
Move cap to QC station.
Take 2x images to confirm sample collection.
Use 10x objective for confirmation of sample.
Ablate excess tissue if necessary.
Remove samples from QC station.
Insert samples into 0.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Place tubes on dry ice.
Store tubes at -80°C until lysis.
Return stage to sample number just collected.
Confirm sample is gone and take image.
Repeat steps 3-9 for all desired samples.
Take a tile image of entire tissue section after sample collection using 2x objective.
